facts.text: Donkey, sit down and eat your stew. Quietly. And if you sing at the table, you are going outside.
facts.why: Not a Shrek line. His real line about the singing is on Wikiquote and is much shorter, so it fits the panel easily.
facts.fix: What did I say about singing?

facts.text: Caught the Shrek way, in the mud bath.
facts.why: Shrek's mud bath is real (he is first seen bathing in mud in his swamp), but no source shows him catching an eel there. Note reworded to keep only the mud bath.
facts.fix: An ogre treat, after Shrek's morning mud bath.

vibe.verdict: Swamp canteen with the right props, and onions, waffles and Gingy are all film-true, but the note is invented and the card is a little busy.
